mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II regarding national appointments announced in February 2026.

List-I
(a) Justice Balbir Singh Chauhan
(b) Dr Jyothi Buddhar Prakash

List-II
(i) CMD, Singareni Collieries
(ii) Chair, committee on Manipur violence

Select the correct code:
mcqs.explanation: Justice Balbir Singh Chauhan was appointed chair of the committee on Manipur violence, while Dr Jyothi Buddhar Prakash became CMD of Singareni Collieries. Therefore, the correct pairs are a-ii and b-i; the other codes interchange or duplicate the appointments.

mcqs.question:
Match the persons in List-I with the positions or distinctions in List-II.

List-I
(a) Dr Vibhavari Nayak
(b) Aditya Pandya

List-II
(i) Clinical Lead, WFSA 2026
(ii) India's youngest male analog astronaut

Select the correct code:
mcqs.explanation: Dr Vibhavari Nayak was appointed Clinical Lead for WFSA 2026, whereas Aditya Pandya was identified as India's youngest male analog astronaut. Hence, a-i and b-ii is the correct matching.

mcqs.question: Who was described as the first and only Indian Governor-General, whose statue was unveiled at Rashtrapati Bhavan during the inaugural Rajaji Utsav?
mcqs.explanation: C. Rajagopalachari was the first and only Indian Governor-General and was honoured with a statue unveiling at Rashtrapati Bhavan during Rajaji Utsav. Rev. Jesse Jackson Sr., Robert Duvall and Shankar were associated with civil rights, acting and Bengali literature respectively.

mcqs.question: Rev. Jesse Jackson Sr., who passed away in February 2026, was particularly known as which of the following?
options: A US civil rights leader after the 1968 assassination of Martin Luther King Jr.
A sociologist who wrote Caste, Class and Power
A travel writer and former Navy Commander
A Bengali writer associated with Chowringhee
mcqs.explanation: Rev. Jesse Jackson Sr. was known as a US civil rights leader after Martin Luther King Jr.'s assassination in 1968. The other descriptions refer to André Béteille, Hugh Gantzer and Shankar respectively.

mcqs.question: Which Bengali writer, known for works such as Chowringhee, Jana Aranya and Seemabaddha, was a Sahitya Akademi awardee?
mcqs.explanation: Shankar, whose full name was Mani Shankar Mukherjee, was the Bengali writer known for Chowringhee, Jana Aranya and Seemabaddha and was a Sahitya Akademi awardee. The other options refer to a statesman, a clinical lead and a committee chair.
